book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Manqos Maado Imo
«Asi inttena beyana mala asa sinththan lo7o ooththontta mala naagettite; hessaththo ooththiko intte salo Aawappe go7a demmeketa.

Intte manqotas maado immiza wode asi tana beyo giidi asa sinththan bonchchettanaas ogeninne Ayhuda Woosa Keeththan xurumba punisiza qoodheppe qommon hanizaytaththo ooththofte. Ta inttes tumu gays; istti ba waaga ubbaa haan ekkida.
Intte manqotas immishin ushachcha kushey ooththizaa hadirsa kushey eroppo.
Intte imoy geeman gido; qotan oosettidayssa be7iza intte Aawaykka intte waaga inttes immana.
Woosa Gishshas

«Intte woossishe qoodheppe qommon hanizayta mala hanopite; istti asi beyana mala Ayhuda woosa keeththataninne oyddu oge bolla eqqidi woossanaas doseettes. Ta inttes tumu gays; istti kumeththa waaga ekkichchida.
Neni woossana geliza ne kifile gela; karekka ne bolla gordada geeman diza ne Aawaakko woossa. Geeman oosettidayssa be7iza ne Aaway ne ooso mala nees immana.
«Ammanontta asay issi qaala zaari zaari woossiko isttas siyettiza misatiin istti zaari zaari gizayssaththo intteka woossishe issi qaala zaari zaari goopite.
Gido attiin intte Aaway intte woossanaappe kasetidi inttes aazi koshshizaakko eriza gishshas intte istta misatopite.
Intte woossishe,

content.text: nekka nu qoho nuus atto ga.

content: «Intte inttena qohidaytas atto giikko intte salo Aawaykka inttes atto gaana.
Qasse intte asa nagara atto gontta ixxiko intte Aawaykka intte nagara atto geenna.
Xooma Gishshas
«Intte xooma xoomishe qoodheppe qommon xoomizaytaththo shullofte. Istti ba xoomizayssa asi erana mala ba ayfeso iisseettes. Ta tumu gays; hessaththo ooththizayti ba waaga kumeth ekkichchida.
Neni xooma xoomashe ne ayfeso meecetta, ne hu7e tiyetta.
Hessaththo ne xoomikko geeman diza ne Aaway xalala erizaazinne asi oonikka erontta qotan gidana. Qotan oosettidayssa be7iza ne Aawaykka ne waaga nees immana.
Salon Diza Haaro
«Bilay mizason buuqqidinne shiydi moorettizason, kaysoy bookkidi kaysanaas dandayzason, ha biittaa bolla inttes miish shiishshofte.
Gido attiin bilay maanaas, buuqqidi woykko shiydi moorettonttason, kaysoy bookki ekkana dandayonttason heen salon inttes miish shiishshite.
Ne miishshay dizason ne wozinay heen dees.
«Ayfey asateththas poo7o; hessa gishshas ne ayfey paxa gidikko, ne kumeththa asateththayka poo7o gidana.
Ne ayfey harganchcha gidikko, ne kumeththa asateththayka dhuma xalla gidana. Histtiko nenan diza poo7oy dhuma gidikko, qasse dhumay waanida girdi gida dhuma gidandee?
«Issi asi nam7u godaas ooththana dandayenna. Issaa ixxidi nam7anththoza dosana; woykko issaa bonchchidi nam7anththoza leqqana; Xoossassinne miishshas nam7atas gaththi ooththanaas dandayettenna.
Daro Qoppofte
«Hessa gishshas ta inttena intte duussa gishshas, ‹Ay miinoo? Ay uyinoo? Ay may7inoo?› giidi hirgofte gays. Shemppoy qumappe, ashoy may7ofe aadhdhennee?
Ane salo kafota xeellite! Zerettenna; maxettenna; di7en qolettenna; gido attiin intte salo Aaway istta mizees. Intte isttafe keehi aadhdheketii?
Ane inttefe daro waayettidi baas imettida layththa bolla hara issi gallas gujjana dandayza asi dizee?
«Qasse may7o gishshas aazas hirgeetii? Ane coo demban diza ciishshata xeellite; daaburettenna woykko suqettenna.
Hessa gishshas ta inttena gizay haray attoshin kawo Solomooneykka ba bonchchora ha ciishshatappe issiney mala lo7o may7ibeenna.
Intteno pace ammanoy dizaytoo! Hach asa ayfen beettidi wonto taman wodhdhana maata hayssaththo mayziza Xoossi inttena hessafe lo7eththi aaththi mayzanaas dandayennee?
Hessa gishshas nu ay maanee? Ay uyanee? Ay may7anee? giidi hirgofte.
Hankko ammanontta asay hayssa demmanaas daro qoppees. Hayssi wuri inttes koshshizayssa intte salo Aaway erees.
Harappe sinththatidi Xoossa Kawoteththa xilloteth koyite; hayti wuri inttes gujettana.
Hessa gishshas wontos keehi qoppofte; wonto metoy wontos aqo; issi issi gallassay baas baas gidiza metora dees.

footnotes.text: Baas imettida layththa bolla hara issi gallas gujjana dandayza asi dizee? gizayssa issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafata birsheththan «Baas diza adussateththaa bolla issi wadha pude gujjanaas dandayza asi dizee?» gizaazi dees.
